annotation.title_clean: 人工知能関連技術の研究開発及び活用の適正性確保に関する指針
annotation.title_en: Guidelines on Ensuring Appropriateness in the Research, Development and Utilization of AI-Related Technologies
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 人工知能戦略本部 (AI Strategy Headquarters, Cabinet Office, Japan)
annotation.summary_en: Japan's AI Strategy Headquarters guideline under Article 13 of the 2025 AI Promotion Act, setting voluntary principles for appropriate AI R&D and use. It sets elements (human-centricity, fairness, safety, transparency, accountability, security, privacy) and duties for developers, deployers, government and citizens. It has no robotics-specific provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Voluntary guideline under Art. 13 of Japan's AI Act, promoting proactive self-governance by all actors
Core elements: human-centricity, fairness, safety, transparency, accountability, security, privacy, fair competition, AI literacy, innovation
Basic policies: risk-based approach, stakeholder engagement, end-to-end AI governance, agile PDCA response
Developers and deployers should build AI governance, ensure transparency, safety, business continuity, and engage data holders
Government to promote AI literacy, review governance, appoint AI governance officers, and lead international coordination via Hiroshima AI Process
